### Description: 
P3A slide buttons color isn't dark blue in dark mode for existing users

### Steps to Reproduce 
  1. Set the device to Dark mode
  2. Clean profile 1.45.x 
  3. Upgrade the profile to 1.46.x
  4. P3A slide buttons color isn't dark blue in dark mode for existing users

**Actual result:** <!-- Add screenshots if needed -->

P3A slide buttons color isn't dark blue in dark mode for existing users

**Expected result:**
As per figma spec, the P3A slide buttons should be in dark blue color in dark mode for existing users
https://www.figma.com/file/irDJRP35FUwsRu60Wp9fM6/iOS-onboarding?node-id=3321%3A54735&t=OHK0wJLjBiri43Xq-0
**Reproduces how often:** [Easily reproduced, Intermittent Issue]
Easy

**Brave Version:** <!-- Provide full details Eg: v1.4.2(17.09.08.16) -->
1.46.x

**Device details:** <!-- Model type and iOS version Eg: iPhone 6s+ (iOS 10.3.3)-->
iPhone 8 - iOS 16.1.1

**Website problems only:**
- did you check with Brave Shields down? NA
- did you check in Safari/Firefox (WkWebView-based browsers)? NA


### Additional Information

cc: @brave/qa-team @kylehickinson @anthonypkeane ",
